text: We went here as duel celebration for my husband's birthday and our friends' anniversary. The service was excellent, the food was delish and they had a great wine list. My only complaint was the "complimentary" birthday dessert. It was simply a single piece of bite sized chocolate with a candle in it. Granted it was complimentary but it would have been nice to have something like a piece of cake or even a cupcake, especially for such a nice place. Regardless, we really liked this restaurant and recommend it.
Totally worth it! The most amazing thing we had was the dessert (flan) topped with pistachio

Stopped in the other day for lunch and had an excellent classic gyro and classic hummus. Gyro had tons of meat and plenty of tzatziki. The pita was soft, fresh, and warm out of the oven.

Overall, price was very reasonable and after filling up, I left with enough leftovers that I ate the rest for dinner and was still full, which is a rarity.

One note: The spicy tzatziki is well-named. I enjoyed the spice level, but I would suggest anyone not comfortable with fairly spicy food either try the regular tzatziki or ask for some on the side first.

Great family-friendly restaurant with hometown cooking! The folks that work here are so, so friendly and accommodating. The food is definitely comfort food with larger-than-most portions, which makes my husband happy. There's plenty of seating and lots of food options for everyone. I would absolutely recommend their Saturday breakfast, especially if you have small children; great food, fast service and spacious.
The worst ever service I've ever had...look at my side orders...are the made for a child...do not use take out...they give you small portions but charge you full price..this place is horrible...

On my first visit I was very impressed.  I came in to order carry out and mentioned I was a 1st timer.  The hostess asked me if I was oils like to try the meats.
, of corse I said yes!  I was able to try pork,chicken, brisket and sausage.  I was sold on the flavor immediately. I judge bbq on taste without sauce, and these meats passed my test.
I proceeded to order a sampler and we were very pleased. I think there prices were very fair and portions were generous. Loved the homemade tortilla chips and guacamole, salsa, and the potato salad.  The charro beans were good could have used more heat/flavor.
The place was very clean and comfortable while I was waiting.  The staff was very friendly and really sold me on this place.


On a return (covid) visit I felt the portions were smaller. We felt the meat was tasteless this time out
I'm from jersey city so I'm definitely a foodie. The food was very bland, i really wanted to like it but the food is just not it
I love that it's only open to focus on what they do best! Breakfast, brunch and early lunch fare!

I was across the street for a conference and stopped by to grab a quick bite. I like
How the meat and veggies were cooked. The famous roast pork sandwich with broccoli was delicious - added provolone cheese and sweet peppers to the hero. Sandwiches are 9.75 , 100-1.75 for various toppings. We ate at the counter and observed how efficient the guys were assembling the sandwiches and gilding orders. The roast pork was tasty but not my fave. I was checking out the brisket which looked mouth watering yummy. Highly recommended and will return.

Sometimes places that have been written up everyone and featured on TV etc. drop the ball and fail to live up to the hype...this was NOT the case at South Philly Barbacoa. It lived up to the hype, and then some. 

I was there around 2pm on a Sunday, I was able to walk right up to the ordering "station" without any line. I stepped to the side and a few minutes later had a plate of Barbacoa - Lamb tacos.

I found a seat inside fairly easily, though I'm sure at other times this might be more difficult. 

As for the taco itself, wow. I've had plenty of tacos all over, these tacos just popped in your mouth with so much flavor. The meat was tender and juicy. The tacos were amazing. The different salsas were great too.

My only desire would be that this place is open every day of the week! Makes it hard if friends aren't visiting on the right days.

Saigon is a famous Vietnamese restaurant that will show up on Yelp when you search for Asian, Thai or Asian fusion cuisines. With the amount of reviews they have, I had been curious to try this restaurant located on the intersection of 38th Street and Georgetown. With ample parking and stand-alone style of construction, you can easily spot this restaurant in the Lafayette Shoppes plaza. Upon entry, we were greeted by a warm male server who took us to a booth by the windows. He quickly brought the menu and my first impression was "Wow, so many options!" Their menu is long and you can find some Thai delicacies also on the menu such as Pad Thai, Crab Rangoon and so on. Another attraction point for this place is that they serve bubble/boba tea which not many sit-down restaurants serve. 

Well coming back to their menu and food. We got crab Rangoon appetizer with Thai iced tea, followed by lemongrass chicken and basil shrimp. Their pho is very famous too! The crab Rangoon appetizer looks super pretty and appetizing. The entrées quickly followed which can assure you that their service is pretty quick too. Since Lemongrass Chicken does not come with veggies, I requested for those to be added and the server happily agreed. Basil shrimp seemed to have some kick/standout flavor missing. Both dishes came with a bowl of white rice. Lemongrass chicken obviously stole attention for me with the aroma and good flavors. I would definitely recommend that and you can choose any protein with tha

Had a reservation for 2 at 8 that we did not need due to the availability. By 8:15 we were one of the only ones in the restaurant yet still could not get any wait staff's attention. We asked our waiter many questions about the menu and he was not able to give us any information about the dishes. We ended up disliking what we got because it was very different than our waiter's explanation.

We enjoyed an early dinner here tonight. The service, food and atmosphere were excellent. We had the jaegerschnitzel and sauerbraten- delicious!  We did get dessert to go, did not care for the apple streudel.  Overall, we recommend dining here!

Loved the atmosphere! Drinks were amazing! Prices are honestly pretty fair. However, if you don't get Garrett as your server, it definitely will not complete the whole experience PS make sure you get him to do the tootsie roll on your birthday
Love love love these wagyu burgers. They are simple, but delicious!!! You may need two and don't forget the pickle!

We came here during Covid-19 so things were a bit different then I assume they normally would be. It was a Saturday night and the wait for a table was an hour and a half. They take your number and send you a list so you can monitor where they are at with seating and then call you when your table is ready. We were able to go to a walk up bar and drinks were really good! We could enjoy the beach while we waited for a table. They were very big on marking the ground to keep people 6 feet apart and tables were placed apart as well which I liked. I can't say the guests were doing their part to social distance but the restaurant did. Food was amazing! I had the garlic crab fries and the seafood salad. They both tasted amazing and we highly recommend either! My boyfriend had grouper with the coconut rice and he really liked his as well! There's a lot on the menu that looks good so we will definitely return when in the area. Also our server Sara was very kind and attentive even though they were busy!

Okay...so first things, wow. When I first tried this place out, I wasn't too impressed but that's probably because I got something I'm not used to eating. I got chicken pho since I'm on a 'no red meat' diet. I'm Vietnamese and I grew up eating pho with beef or meatballs so it wasn't my cup of tea. I was definitely impressed with the customer service though. The owner gave us free dessert and a free smoothie and I looove free!!! That alone was good enough to keep me coming back, and boyyyyy let me tell you...I'm sho glad I did! lol. This time I was willing to have a cheat day and I opted for pho with beef and got rice with pork chops to share with my boyfriend and oh my God *foodgasm* it was amazing!!! Like I said, I grew up eating this food but this is the BEST Vietnamese restaurant I've been to thus far and I'll explain why. 

1) the pho - so I've always been the one to freakin add basically half a bottle of hoisin sauce and sriracha in my pho, but at this place that was not needed at all. Initially when they gave us the pho and a little bit of sauce on the side I was like huh?! This is def not gonna be enough for me...But it actually was! And that speaks volumes. That means the broth is good enough on it's own. 

2) the rice and pork chops - that thang came out glistening and sizzling like it was seducing me, but we were so full from the pho that we took it to-go. We ate it about 2-3 hours later and it stillllllll tasted amazing so that's how I know that it's good, period.
Just moved to Nashville from Chicago. I'm still trying to find my favorite spots and The Perch did not disappoint.    The crepes, the waffles, the tea selection...all impressive.

One of the best slices in the City of Philadelphia for pizza enthusiasts and casual pizza fans alike. Slices  have a crispy thin crust with a slight char, perfectly balanced red sauce, gooey cheese and fresh toppings. As a rule, everytime I go (as should you) I ORDER THE SPECIAL! You won't be disappointed, they might switch up meats from time to time or not have any at all, but THE SPECIAL is a white pizza with a mouth watering buttery crust, melty mozzarella and ricotta cheese. Seasoned to perfection, so no need to ask for any. All in all, pizza at it's finestsee u there.......

Great atmosphere, amazing food. Everything we ordered was a delight: the twice fried potatoes were crisp on the outside and fluffy on the inside with a spicy harissa dipping sauce that made them sing, the gnochetti were of an excellent texture consistency and the flavors were warm and comforting like a hug from the Italian Grandmother you never had, and the steamed mussels were radiant, even with the slight dietary modifications the chef was so happy to make for us. Our server, Scott, was friendly, knowledgeable, and skilled with his attentiveness. I will go back to explore their menu more as it changes with the seasons.

Great place the food not so much 
All attraction is real and the kids love it 
I do recommended this place to everyone

We had the grouper sandwich - excellent with a side of coleslaw.
Cooked perfectly.
Fast and friendly.

The deviled crab has a tomato paste base, not for me.

Best nashville hot chicken ive had so far. Has multiple choices form mild to very hot. I got the hot and the heat was perfect. Baked beans were delicious. Staff was very friendly. Fresh lemonade was very refreshing. Lastly the banana pudding was magnificent!! 7/5 stars better than 5 stars

I really don't understand the hype at all, but I guess when it comes to chain restaurants this is as good as it's going to get. We came here to celebrate a birthday and it was a party of four. If you call ahead on the same day you can technically make reservations or as they explained it- be priority on the waitlist (a little confusing). Our server was less than enthusiastic throughout the evening, but she waited on us appropriately. Even with the mask on you could tell she was quite somber. The food was surprisingly good. The portions are good enough for two meals. The entrees come with a soup or salad which makes the prices here justifiable. I'd rather support family-owned businesses, but if I had to pick a chain then I guess this one was not so bad.
I adore this plan. Chicken dumplings are amazing, bento boxes are amazing, and everything is very reasonably priced!

I'm being generous with 3 stars because I'm basing it on one visit.  My wife ordered fish and didn't like it. She never complains about fish.  My hamburger sucked.  If I had to guess it was a frozen  patty.   I was asked how I wanted it cooked.  I asked if they will actually cook it the way I asked, because most places can't seem to do it.   She said yes they do here.  I ordered it medium.   We did a takeout and jumped on the boat.  The hamburger was very well done.  It was a big diameter hamburger, but very thin.  Maybe the thickness of a McDonald's quarter pounder. That's probably why it's well done or nothing.   I certainly will not return for a hamburger.
I really love this place. It's something a little different for Brownsburg. A large selection of sushi and the Hibachi food is delicious. The YumYum sauce. OMG, I could seriously drink that stuff.

We Decided to try Olio E Limone after a big wine tasting at the Hilton hotel in SB.
We walked in, group of 8.
As a welcome we get treated by a waiter that didn't seemed too thrilled to see us. 
Without even greeting us He told us "just so you know this is not the pizzeria" (with a heavy accent)
We were nicely dressed and honestly, may be because we were young He thought He wasn't gonna get a tip or I don't know what was His deal.
The majority of the group felt very uncomfortable, and to be fair the appearance of our waiter wasn't the best too much facial hair and honestly kind of hippyish looking! I mean you work in a fine dining establishment!  
But anyways, we wanted to try it. 
After we order some drinks he kind if seemed upset we didn't all order cocktails! 
But anyways we got to the food, got Caprese salad and some other appetizers, they were all good! 
Main course was good too, nothing to brag about! 
Prices are ok! For what you get it's a little overpriced! 
I got the rack of Lamb, cooked perfectly but unfortunately didn't taste as good as it should! 
But since I have very high expectations when it comes to lamb it's all good, not judging!
I don't mind spending 100+/person for a nice dinner but it needs to be good! 
I'm giving it 4 stars because we had a Bussboy that really made the whole experience better. 
He was very helpful and very profesional. 
I might give it an other chance! 
Or may be their Pizzeria!  
I love pizza!

No stars. Do not eat at PF Chang's Brentwood. So disappointed, as this was one of our favorite places to eat. Matt went to get take out tonight and said the place is a mess. Worst management he has seen and VERY poorly ran. His years of being in this business validates his opinion. That's not even the worst of it. After waiting 30 minutes, he gets our food. We are starving. He brings it home. I ordered tuna rolls. In the bowl, are my tuna rolls, with shrimp that has been eaten and thrown back in the bowl. No joke.  WTH??
This was some darn good coffee. Extremely smooth it had a distinct flavor. The employees were super nice and the location is extremely clean I will be back.

I went to High Street on Market spur of the moment for brunch with a friend. Considering it was a Sunday morning at 10:30am, I was surprised we did not have to wait. I ordered the Nutella waffles which were appropriately portioned and perfectly crispy. Of course, more Nutella never hurts!

I am a Titanium Elite I have been to many locations. My friend and I had the most amazing time at this bar/restaurant. The bar staff was amazing especially Arla she was engaging and enlightening. We had a hard time deciding what to drink. She asked us what our favorite flavors were and made us the most amazing drinks.

Ava in Tampa's SoHo area certainly raises the bar for service and bar and food selections. Exciting energy as soon as you enter, the decor and open layout between with dining area, bar, and kitchen keeps the energy flowing while somehow keeping the noise level low for easy conversations .

The special appetizer plate was perfect with my favorites. The salmon was done perfectly, just right between tender medium rare and medium well; my new benchmark for salmon, and the grilled flavor carried through.  Our special dessert plate was more than we could finish!

Beer selection was just right and included hard to find local craft brews.  My benchmark bourbon and an orange twist was also perfectly poured.

Can't wait to return!

Experience tonight was horrible. 15 minutes to get greeted and another 10 minutes after that to get drinks on the table. We got 2 waters and an iced tea. We were Kamm's only table in the restaurant at the time and she couldn't have cared any less about us being there. The lack of care or hospitality was some of the most lackluster I've ever seen (been cooking professionally for 15 years). After taking our order and the food coming out pretty quickly and hot (that was the only positive point to the meal) we were ghosted the rest of the meal. No drink refills at all and 2 of us ordered the unlimited wings. Our server then proceeded to pull up a trash can to the table next to us about 3 feet away and SIT at a dirty table and count her tips while shoveling food into the trash can in the middle of the dining room. At some point throughout our meal every employee in the restaurant was on their cell phone in the dining room, every server, the cook and even the "manager".  The absolute neglect for standards at this place is embarrassing. There was absolutely zero leadership. Maybe the manager shouldn't be on his phone vaping by the front door when guests walk in. I would be absolutely embarrassed if I was the manager on duty at the time. The lack of care all around was astonishing. There is zero chance we'll be back.

Turning Point is a cute little breakfast/brunch spot in Media. The food was good, and the service was great!

The breakfast menu was good! Nothing that blew me away, but it was a tasty breakfast. A friend I was dining with did get the Ruben Turkey Melt from the lunch menu and said it had a little too much cheese for her liking (hence why some of it is pulled off in the picture), but was otherwise very good! I'm looking forward to returning and trying the lunch menu. I suggest giving Turning Point a try when deciding where to go to get breakfast/brunch in Media!

New Year's Eve at the Silver Saddle. Perfect choice my friends. I ordered the sampler as I wanted to try a little bit of everything. The ribs fell of the bone and tasted amazing, the chicken was juicy and smothered in their bbq. The stead was cooked to my perfection at medium rare as requested, a lot of places cannot do that right as I like the outside nice and cooked with that smoky flavor and the inside still sinking without a bloody mess in my plate. I cannot say it enough it was perfection!
The food was soooo good! I'm in love with the Land & Sea pasta. The service was also excellent. I'll definitely be returning.
Nice place for dinner. Nothing notable to remember, but overall it was decent. The Atlantic Salmon, Fettuccine Alfredo, and and shrimp tempura were pretty good. Best part is the atmosphere.

Mall sushi. Eh, sometimes you want what you know and it's ok to have just ok. It's a nice mall and a fun environment but it doesn't knock your socks off. Takeout is especially meh, even when eaten immediately in the parking lot. A good place to take newbie sushi eaters but I'd rather have no sushi than have this....

Highly suggested by locals and was super impressed by the service and ambience. Staff is really nice and the bartenders Darren (?) and Ryan are the best! Try the Baba Ganoush and the Fried Chicken Hummus paired with their amazing and fresh pita! Thank you Shaya for the wonderful experience!

THIS PLACE IS SO DELICIOUS! The bread is sooooooo good and to die for every time. Today I grabbed a GOBBLER and too bad I ate it far to quick to take a picture. It has the most incredible flavor for a thanksgiving sandwich. I added the ligonberry and what a good decision that was! Bravo on the flavor and greatness of this place!!!!!

The owner is one of the nicest people ever! You can tell from the minute you walk in, he loves his customers. The food is very good and seems the closest we have had to the "in-and-out" west coast feel. We drive from Spring Hill to keep supporting  The only reason for not giving 5 stars is for feeling like I can't touch the tables. I hate feeling sticky tables. ‍

Adele's was a very cute restaurant and we were so excited to try it out. The front desk hostesses were not welcoming at all, had a glare on the whole time- maybe because we were Asian. She then sat us in the corner and then our waitress came over to help us and she was the sweetest girl ever. The food was good, but it doesn't really justify the high price for what it was. I've had better food for half the price. This place would be good for a pretty brunch IG post, but that's about it.

We stopped in here on a Sunday morning at 9:45 and it was popping! Luckily we checked in online and only had to wait 15 minutes. The current wait was 45 when we got there. 

Our server was beyond pleasant from start to finish which was much appreciated. He brought water and menus immediately and was so thoughtful in making recommendations and telling us popular items. 

We ultimately ordered the bacquezo omelette with skillet potatoes and a half order of biscuit beignets, all to share between the two of us. 

The omelette was DELISH. Omg. I've never thought to fill one with cream cheese, it was life changing. The skillet potatoes were super hot, crisp, and excellent, we loved them. The dish was served with an English muffin as well but we skipped it since we were eating the beignets. 

The beignets were a decent size, and the half order came with 4. It was plenty. Very warm, fresh, and covered in powdered sugar. They came with peach preserves for dipping, and that was the best part. Very good. 

We'll definitely visit here again! Total bill was $23.

I went here for Mother's Day and it was a mess. There were orders that weren't ready even 3 hours after their promise time. I was invited back to try them again and I did last night. I think this location just needs new management or new service standards. First my order was ready 20 minutes later no apology only if I wanted to leave a tip. Second the salad was just hunks of lettuce. Third the extra breadsticks I bought were all burned past the point of eating. Finally my fettuccine was inedible due to the fact the noodles were so overcooked they were crunchy. Will not return and will not recommend
Best Dutch in town! The manager, Lauren, is amazing! She always remembers my order, is personable, & efficient.  I love all stands but this is definitely my fave!

This is a Covid dining experience review. So I've been to gurus before and I loved it. I find all the food to be delicious and the atmosphere to be homey and comforting. We ordered the butter chicken, paneer tikka masala and lamb chops. The lamb chops are absolutely out of this world. I really encourage everyone to go and try them. Cooked to perfection. The chef is extremely friendly and came out to greet us in addition to sending out an extra dish and desserts for us to try. I think they took good precautions considering the situation as well. I've already been back for take out

How unfortunate that your server, Jacob C., made this comment to us at the beginning of last evening:  At the time to order, we hesitated to see who would go first - so before anyone spoke up, Jacob C. got impatient and said, "Let's not order all at once, now."  
I would like to know if this is the type of treatment and sarcasm we can come to expect from your establishment.  No matter how good the food is or the service (which it wasn't), this comment is unacceptable.

Worst location too choose from each and every one of those people in that dominos don't even know what they are doing those people are lazy they don't care about getting it too you nor they don't care about your time pizza is always cold and they always take 2+ hours to deliver and they never want too compensate anything

Going here was an after thought but I am glad I went. I planned to go the Dots further down airline but they were closed for electrical issues. The staff are not the most engaging but they did do their job. I ordered the soup of the day which was a corn and crab bisque and the siracha ham sandwich. Both were very good. It was unexpected. It was a little late in the day to order coffee but I wish I had now that I liked the food so much. I think most people over look this place but it is a nice place and I will be back for that coffee.

So good! I love that they source ingredients from other local places and couldn't wait to try them out after I saw them suggested on a list of local Black-owned restaurants. I finally got to try them out and it didn't disappoint (I'm only disappointed that I decided not to order doughbuds, but next time). I had the trap pizza and my husband had a half trap and half woodstock. It all was delicious, totally worth the wait, and we'll definitely be back to try the Spinarella next!
The agua fresca wasn't great for the price I would have thought there would be more fruit but it tasted like it came from a koolaid packet

We were very hungry when we entered Reading Terminal market.  We went through aisle after aisle of food stores and settled for Kamal's because of the Adam who is one of the family members who owns and runs the store. His personality stands out who is very knowledgeable woth the food menu and can accommodate all special request.
They have been in RTM for 28 years and offers amazing quality food at affordable prices. 
We ordered Lamb Gyro, Saturday pie, specially smoothie, Mini Rose Cashew baklava and Chocolate and Cashew Halava.
We will definitely come again and broadcast referrals how good they are.

Stumbled upon this place while taking a walk on the beach. I don't know why it doesn't have five stars. We loved our drinks(the chunky monkey and pina colada) as well as our meals. The tacos were amazing and my husbands cheeseburger was delish. We also loved the ambience, skilled live music that wasn't too loud and had a laidback vibe. Stunning view of the ocean and no wait to be seated. We went back again later in the week and it was just as good. Will definitely visit again next time we're in Clearwater!

The worse customer service ever. I go here regularly. I live in the neighborhood . I usually only go when I'm on a budget. But I get sick of them closing a hour early just so they can leave. The job isn't done until business hours is over. This is a huge problem. I just called outside the door to place a phone order due to corona an I literally watched the girl pick the phone up an hang up on me. It was so rude an unnessacary. The people they hire take no pride into making the food or makin the customer feel appreciated .It gets upsetting spending my  hard earned money on food at a establishment that doesn't appreciate my money. I wouldn't recommend people going to this place. I don't usually do this. Only when it's needed.

Why does Kappy's mention happy hour between certain times.... 
but ....
NO HH choices or prices?
$5.25 for a very tiny cocktail during posted HH times?  hmmmmmm
Why don't they chop the taters for the potato salad ?
Did the kitchen just forget ?  huh?
Trying to eat whole small potatoes in tater salad makes it not so enjoyable.
Friday fish fry - that means 3 pieces of fish ONLY for $12.00 !
Nothing else comes with it !!!!
Unable to eat my unappetizing whole tater tater salad!
Friendly - that's why they're as popular as they are with the local neighborhood & bar dwellers.
ripoff.

I was on the road and passing through town and the bright blue cheerful exterior caught my eye and looked like a nice casual place to stop for a bite to eat. Everyone was super friendly and the Turkey ribs were delicious! 
I also enjoyed an iced hibiscus tea :)

Weekday early dinner.  The finest German restaurant I have found in the US.  Doesn't look like much from the street but you step thru the door and you are in a different world.  The schnitzel was awesome.  Large servings and perfect service.  Make reservations.  Seemed like they have loyal, regular customers.

I was quite disappointed by this restaurant. It is your typical seafood boil chain restaurant. We got the seafood platter with the boom sauce. The sauce was saltier than the ocean. It actually made me slightly ill because it was so salty. In addition, the sauce was just like sediment at the bottom with some clumps really not mixed in. I was annoyed on how they wanted to up sell everything. Our waitress was very friendly and attentive, but she definitely suggested ordering pricier things that we didn't want. We, initially got the platter small but we were convinced to go for the large because we were told it wouldn't be enough food. We ended up having plenty of food. Also she asked us if we wanted the headless shrimp without telling us it was an extra charge. 
We left feeling slightly duped and regretting spending that much money on a mediocre lunch.

Anniversary destination: Mystic Fish! The design of this restaurant did not disappoint.  The music was great and at the right volume, the tables were laid out nicely and there was great artwork on the wall, sculptural lights, fish tanks, photos of anemones... the works. It was really visually appealing!
We ordered cocktails and they were really delicious! We ordered the escargot (because we have slightly exotic taste in food) and it was fantastic. The escargot was in a curry butter and that touch of curry was wonderful!
For 2nd course, he had the fish soup which the waiter recommended. It was so different, really interesting and tasty. I had the crab martini, which was fresh jumbo lump crabmeat in a martini glass. It was more prepared than cooked, but a really solid classic dish.
I opted for the steak tartare for my entree and it was definitely entree sized. The menu says 4 oz but it definitely seemed like 8! I had a major complaint about this dish - they actually fried the bread slices and it was oily and tasted like pure oil and really hid the flavor of the tartare. We called the waiter over and asked for just toasted bread. It was much improved without the oily mess!
My husband had the duck and it was delish. We switched dishes halfway thru.
I'll keep it on my list for a special occasion restaurant! After 4 cocktails, 4 apps and an entree then bill was $110. 
Oh, I won't be bringing my kids here, I think I'll keep this one for the adults!

Chariot Pizza is doing a great job of take-out during this Corona Crisis! Their website, http://chariotpizza.com, is very easy to navigate and we able to shape our orders just to our liking. The food is great, the prices are great, and the service is topnotch! Thanks for taking such great care of us!!!
This is probably a little on the pricey side for the value but the food and drinks were good, especially the Shrimp and Grits and the Pain Perdu.

Don't let the look of this place scare you, go inside! You won't regret it! The first day we stopped there hubby and I split a small Cuban sandwich. Even splitting it there was more than we could eat. It is packed with so much meat you won't believe it. It's not your traditional Cuban sandwich, I've never had one with lettuce and tomato before. I actually hesitated when asked if I wanted it all the way and thought about making it more traditional but decided to go for it. I'm so glad I did, it was the best damn one I've ever had.

So the next day my husband was out and said his car somehow drove there. He brought home a HUGE plate of chicken, yellow rice and black beans. It was so good I almost cried. It took me right back to when we lived in Miami. There was enough for dinner for two in that box.

Was craving an iced coffee and so I stopped in here since it was just up the road from where I was at. When it comes to local coffee shops/roasters, I tend to be skeptical because most have this distinct taste (almost floral bitter like) that I absolutely hate. When I went in I asked the front desk if their coffee had those type of notes, he said a little bit very subtle. I then saw they had nitro which I had always been wanting to try. He was nice that he gave me a sample, unfortunately it had that distinct taste. So I opted for a chai tea with coconut milk. It cost over $5 for a 16oz (yikes) and crazy enough it also had that distinct floral sour taste. I was baffled and unfortunately threw out about 3/4 of the beverage. I just couldn't do it. Overall a hip little store with friendly service. Gave it 2 stars because of the nice counter gentleman.

Excellent service and STRONG drinks!  Great place for a date night with attentive service, good food and definitely not for families.  Angeled eggs were sooo good - cheese platter just ok.  Short ribs, duck and Bannanas foster really, really good!  Did not leave hungry!  Service was top notch!

Touted as one of the best brunch spots in NOLA, it lived up to the hype during our visit. Our waitress was able to customize our order to our liking and it was delicious. We loved the trendy and cozy ambiance, as well as the open layout of the restaurant. We would love to come back!

I sat down and got my drink 30 seconds before the department of professional regulation announced that no alcoholic drinks are to be served. It was an old fashioned and it was delicious!

Wanted to try something new so I got the same thing I always get. Avocado toast and empanadas. The empanadas scared me at first because theyre eggplants but they were surprisingly very delicious. The bartender suggested them and she was spot on.

The avocado toast needed salt but that's about it. Other than that it was delicious. I really liked the decor. It's very trendy and I like the inside/outside bar seating. This is where you take someone on a date when you're cool, but not really.

Price is about 2 dollar signs, its really not that bad. Staff wears masks and provide sanitizer when needed. Contactless menu.

I got a pizza delivered to my home and it was the most disgusting pizza I have ever had. The crust was so brittle and the center of pizza was mushy. The bottom of pizza completely burnt. You guys need a new pizza man! Terrible!
Great Pizza.  Good luck trying to reach someone to order takeout.

I had a pretty bad experience here. I found TWO FLIES in my punch bowl. Originally we ordered a punch bowl to split and the waitress accidentally brought a Sangria bowl. We told our waiter we ordered the punch bowl instead and so when they replaced it, the punch bowl had literally zero alcohol in it and I found 2 flies in the punch bowl. If I could give 0 stars I would! Stay away!

Walked past this place and saw everyone enjoying their time and luscious plates of food. So glad we stopped. The food and service were awesome. 

Definitely recommend Apricot Stone to everyone. I know I will come back
Love tailgate, like the atmosphere and the food. Good choice!! Haven't been since they opened their ice cream shop, but I am sure I will like that too. Can't wait to go back

I'm a big fan of Thai curries and I have to say this is one of the best Massaman curries I have had and the delicious and unusual addition of a meaty tender lamb shank is genius! Service was attentive and friendly. Beautiful dining room with water feature in the center.

Wow, put in an order for an apps and it never came out. Waited over an hour and we finally canceled the order. The manager came by and agreed to take it off our bill. We had also ordered dinner and it was good, not amazing.  The pizza is consistently good, fish sandwich and turkey burger were ok. Just disappointed that the food took so long to come out and the dishes were brought out at different times.

I've been wanting to try this place for a while now and finally went for dinner as I don't drink coffee. Having read some of the reviews, I was a bit surprised with the service we received...the servers were perfectly "nice" (we had two, which I found strange) but the vibe was just super snobby in a we're-hipster-and-you're-not kind of way. 

I asked at the beginning if it was possible to switch to another table and was told that it wasn't possible because of the way the schedule was organized. Then, my friend and I ordered two half portions of pasta and was asked "are you sure? How hungry are you? You should order more because this isn't a lot". We said we weren't too hungry and that maybe we'd add to the order later if it wasn't enough. The server immediately said, "oh no, we only take complete orders because our kitchen is small and can't handle it otherwise". I've never heard this before and I eat out A LOT. Well, their loss if they want to lose out on more money I guess? 

The food was good, we had the spaghetti vongole and the orecchiette with beans (heirloom, obvi). The spaghetti came with a bunch of clams and we were excited to dig in...only to find that the clams were mainly empty. We probably had about 2 or 3 pieces of clam meat each? I briefly mentioned this to the (other) server, who then went on to explain to me that they cook the clams with the shells in the broth and so the meat sometimes falls out. Um, I'm aware of how that works, but maybe next time don't ser

Muffuletta Sandwich is great if you like olives. Even though, i am not the biggest fan of olives, this sandwich wasnt half bad. You can both taste and smell the olive spread within the sandwich. The salami was fresh and potent. The bread is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The sandwich is worth a stop.

Came here with a small group on a Saturday afternoon. Ordered a chocolate nut party crepe to share and two teas -- one Jasmine boba tea and one peach green boba tea. The crepe itself was fine, decent ice cream and other ingredients. The boba tea was offensively bad. The Jasmine one came from a powder and tasted nothing like Jasmine milk tea. The peach green tea was clearly over-brewed and incredibly tannic. We ended up throwing them both out. 

If you're looking for crepes, this place may do the trick. But avoid the boba tea.

Tuesday means only ONE THING...TACOS!! Or in this case...TAQUITOS! If you need a place to go next week for #tacotuesday, I got just the place...and Red Mesa Cantina did NOT disappoint. These chicken taquitos were soooooo good, I should have ordered my own(sharing is tough sometimes!) Had a little kick to the crema, but absolutely delicious!!

we went for my sons birthday.  he made the reservations.  because of Covid-19 they brought sides to the table and they were very good.  However the meat choices were not as advertised, no filet, no ribs, no salmon, the meats brought were good.  Some of our party came because of the choices advertised and not served.  If they are offering a limited menu it should be advertised on the web site or when reservations are made.   For five people the bill was around $385.  Just was not worth it.  Maybe with all the choices? the desserts were very good.   Advertise what you are actually serving,  if not,  you are ripping people off.

Placed a to go order online on a Saturday afternoon. Was given a time the food would be ready for pickup. Arrived about 5 minutes early, and texted the number to alert them. While waiting, I saw an employee bring out food to another car that was waiting when I pulled up. This employee was wearing a mask. Our food was brought out by an umasked employee 10-15 minutes after the pickup time. Mind you, I donned a mask to protect the employee. Unfortunately, I wasn't given the same courtesy. The rolls were hard and not up to their normal deliciousness. The beloved creole mustard sauce that comes with the catfish dinner was not included even though it was checked during the ordering process. Took off a star due to lack of mask by the employee during a pandemic. Food was 3 stars. Other carryout experience at another location was better.
They completely messed up my order and tried to blame it on me. I waited and waited and then realized they hadn't even started it. I Will not go back.

The food was good and the drinks delicious. Got an assortment of different taco's and sides which was fun. They've got this annoying ordering system going on at the moment due to Covid. Not worth getting into but don't let it stop you from going if your at KOP mall. The real star here though was the manager, Cory. He made the somewhat frustrating ordering system a non issue and really went above and beyond to keep our food and drinks flowing. I hope someone in management reads this review because Cory was outstanding.  Thank you! Kim and Ed Downingtown

After coming here several times to grab coffee and croissants, we finally made it here for dinner!  The space is beautiful - love the decor and the atmosphere.  Service was great.  We were taken care of by Terrance, who I've seen mentioned in a few other reviews and he was excellent.

The wine list is almost exclusively French, which it should be.  Fabulous choices for both red, white and champagne.  We started with the Chicken Liver Pate and the Escargot.  I enjoyed both.  The pate was good and the escargot was different.  They do theirs with mushrooms - no garlic or butter anywhere on the plate.  I liked it but definitely love my garlic butter with snails.

On the mains we went with the popular choice of potato crusted snapper over grilled ratatouille and my husband had the bouillabaisse.  The entrees were fantastic.  As someone else said, the bouillabaisse was loaded with seafood and the broth was delicious.   The snapper was really good too - would have liked a little more eggplant in the ratatouille - but that is really nit picking.

We couldn't say no to dessert (and I need to start saying no) and tried the bread pudding.  That was delicious (some sort of bourbon glaze)!

Happy to have a fun little French place here in St Pete and looking forward to trying lunch or brunch (i was super intrigued by the DLT - where D=Duck bacon!!!!!)

It was as expected except for the short staff. It took forever to get service. Food was surprisingly good. We will do it again but try to get the 6pm dinner rather than the 7:45 next time. We spent most of our tour inside dining.

My first time going to IHOP. We went during the evening. The food was very good for the most part. Steak a little overcooked but not a big deal. The service on the other hand was not good. Ill preface this by saying I used to be a server so I know how it can be. This was very bad service. It wasn't busy and there werent tables already sitting that were being taken care of. We got our drinks at a reasonable time, ordered an appetizer and didn't see the server again until the app came out(15-20 minutes) my boyfriend needed sugar but we didn't see her to ask for addition so his coffee got cold, I didn't let him complain about it because things happen. Gave our food order and waited. When the food came out something was missing,it happens no big deal. I figured she forgot to put it in. She leaves and we don't see her for about 20 minites, we have no napkins,no ketchup, no steak sauce and no refills. She finally comes back with what she forgot to put in the system. Gets us what we requested (only 2 napkins when I asked for extra) and disappears again. As I said I used to be a server so I give a good amount of leeway, she was no where to be seen AGAIN. Figure oh well. Eat our food. When she finally comes back we get boxes she drops the check and disappears AGAIN. We had to wait for her to return to get an additional bag. Long story short. Food was very good, service was horrible.Tha only way that I would eat there again was if I was getting take out. Now the manager asked how thing

Recently I moved to the area and so the hunt began for decent Chinese takeout.  (It's been a rough search). I worked in center city for over 10 years and lived in NE Philly my entire life.  I've had Chinese takeout from at least 30 different restaurants in ne Philly center city area and most of them are better than the Chinese restaurants in Montgomery County and surrounding areas. Since I moved I've visited at least 5 Chinese restaurants in this area and none were better than Noodle Eighty Eight.  

I had the general tso chicken with whole grain rice.  it was very good and I could tell this was made fresh with real chicken (not processed?. For the first time I had whole grain rice and I wasn't disappointed.  

I ordered ahead of time and it was ready when I arrived.  I believe the owner took care of me when I arrived and he seemed like an okay guy but I had very little interaction with him.  

I'll definitely be back.  Yes the menu is priced higher than other Chinese restaurants but I'll gladly pay for better quality!

Gave it one star bc there honestly wasn't anything lower. We've ordered take out twice from here now and both times were shorted food and also what food we did get was very low quality. Couldn't even finish a filet mignon (which is hard for me to do as this is my favorite steak) but I couldn't go on about how bad this food actually is. We will not be returning to this Logan's again. Been to others that were much better but this seems to miss the mark every single time. I would NOT recommend this Logan's to anyone.
Loved the burger. Perfect for COVID with an outside sitting. Not sure why this place has only three starts. My fiancé are usually picky with food and everything here is pretty consistent.

On first glance, not too bad. But they can improve a lot. Portion sizes are good, but not on the stuff that counts (protein). I had a turkey club sandwich and there was only about 2oz on a triple decker sandwich. The service was slow only because there was one server which is understandable, but there was another woman (blonde, maybe the owner?) that was setting a table while we sat there waiting for our server. As a former restaurant employee, she should have prioritized the customers and took our order, then finish setting the table. The interior decor is very schizophrenic and in need of updating to a cohesive style, and a deep cleaning.
Average Mexican food. Lacks any authentic taste and is probably frozen. Enchiladas taste more like sauce than actual enchiladas. Wouldn't recommend. Try Guzman Y Gomez.

Traveling out here from the Bay Area, this totally beats Chinese restaurant out there. This place is sooooo flavorful and the portion are big but totally worth it.  The lettuce wraps are delicious! Had the beef and green bean , yummy.  Oooh and the chow-mein , bomb af!! Highly recommend

This place is amazing! My Indian husband was craving Indian food during our vacation in New Orleans. We all had dosas and they taste just like they are supposed to. The whole space is beautiful and it is convenient that other restaurant options are available too. Would highly recommend Tava.
Great food, great service, and authentic NOLA atmosphere. My favorites were the sausage, ribs, baked beans, and jalapeño cornbread muffins. The pies looked pretty amazing, too!

Had the chimichanga with chicken it was super delicious. My wife had the shrimp enchilada and the red sauce was very tasty. The salsa bar was fresh and could not stay out of it.

Staff and service was top notch friendly and only wish they could accept tip through credit card (no cash on us).

It was my first time at Tampa Bay Brewing Co yesterday. I'm visiting so I wasn't very familiar with the area. I sat at the bar and I have to point out that Ethan took such great care of me and my friends. I'm the worst and super picky about what I drink but he gave me such great recommendations and didn't hesitate to fully describe and explain the beers and make recommendations to me. He was so kind and was able to handle my picky ness while still taking great care of everyone else. He made me and my friends feel like a part of the community. I just had to come on here and brag on his service! Thank you Ethan ! We will definitely be back! And I will tell my family and friends in the area to come and check this awesome place out!

I saw crawfish in their sign and it immediately hooked me in. We were driving around and saw it and had to try this place out. SO glad we did! I got a pound of crawfish and did all three flavored sauces , hottest heat lvl, AMAZING, so good! I like to remove the meat from the shells and let them soak into the sauce, this way it doesn't lack flavor whatsoever. I also added boiled eggs in the mix and let it soak into the sauce. My friend got a pound of the clams w/ garlic butter sauce and he was obsessed! He also got sausages for his extra side. It also 
comes with corn on the cob, red skin potatoes, and fried rice, so much food! Everything was so delicious! We will definitely be back!
Excellent steak. Unmasked staff so kind of skeeved out but figured that is what I was in for before hand. If you are cool with that I would definitely recommend a cheesesteak from here

Don't order from these guys on Uber eats if they are within an hour of closing. Your order will sit for 30+ minutes with no update. You'll be charged and told "if you want your food, drive here and get it yourself because we are closed".

I have been following them on Instagram for awhile and decided to finally go there for breakfast. I got the peach cobbler pancakes and a side order of bacon and grits. All were delicious I have no complaints about any of the food.

The waiter was very friendly and my food came  quick after I ordered it. You can park in the back. I will definitely add them to my rotation of eateries in and around my neighborhood.

I'm in Boise for a couple weeks for work, and I've already been to Taj Mahal twice. The owner and his wife cook everything from scratch, and they're extremely sweet and attentive. They use all fresh herbs and spices, and it definitely shows in their food. The lunch buffet has the perfect amount of choices. The samosas, kofta meatballs, and chicken tikka masala were my favorite! Their dishes have that fragrant authentic Indian flavor. They also bring fresh naan to the table, and for $10.50 for the lunch buffet, you can't beat it!

Two for one cocktail list -Every day
Shrimp bisque- very good, rich and thick
Grouper good and fresh

Worth the hype! Went Friday for happy hour, got there right at 4 so we could for sure get a seat at the bar.  We probably didn't need to ge there that early, but the bar, which has a lot of seating, was fully packed by 4:45. Very nice wines and 3 local beers on tap. And praise be, one of them wasn't Jai Alai. Some nice bites on the happy hour menu. We had oysters that came with a nice truffle mignonette. Not a steal at 2 bucks per, but better than the 3.50 they normally charge. They were good. Then we split the 22 oz bone-in ribeye accompanied with a truffle butter. The steak was delish and no problem with us sharing. Amber, our bartender, was THE BEST. Great first experience overall. Can't wait to go back.

Good food, our waiter, Chris(I think that was his name,  When he gave me his name through the mask I missed what he said and I was too embarrassed to ask him again)...  my 6 friends and I came in last night for the 1st time and played Trivia. Wow!  That was a lot of fun!  I am not a big Trivia person but it was fun to play last night!  My TAILS tasted very very good..  A little pricey at $14  in my opinion....  My drinks ( and my wife's ) were weak especially since I was allegedly paying for doubles...   The only reason I am giving 3 instead of 5 is because of the weak "DOUBLE" drinks...  and I mentioned it to our server twice...  We will be back because we loved the food and the server and the Trivia. Hopefully the bartender will rectify the issues with the drinks the next time we are back

I've been wanting Italian style since quarantine (and not just pizza) so why not get take out to be safe.  Honestly didn't have too many expectations but everything I ordered was delicious.  I ordered the chicken salad, it was extremely fresh and not wilted, also the pesto tortellini with buttered shrimp,it was still hot and so fresh(straight from pan to Togo box), and hummus with cucumbers and olives, it could use some work but it tied in perfectly with everything else.  Extremely satisfied with my to-go experience.  During this time, you definitely see what companies really wanna cater to fellow man even when it comes to food and it was much appreciated personally.
Great food and service what a gem this place is. oysters are amazing and the server was great.

Ordered online curbside pick up a few times from this location. Ordering online is easy and convenient, only complaint is that more than once they forgot something on the order. Due to Covid, there's not many places offering curbside, so I will be returning when I need a quick lunch. They have dedicated parking spaces for pickup right out front.
Our favorite Vietnamese resto in the south. Everything just tastes so good and extra. Service is excellent, too. Love this place and will recommend everytime

Absolutely amazing food. I ordered the two meat combo with rice. The Filipino BBQ pork on a skewer was exactly was I was craving and the lechon I ordered was crispy but not dry. I also ordered a side of lumpia and I think it's the best lumpia I ever had. Friendly staff. Very clean. It's a shame I live so far or else I'd be a regular.

I usually love Denny's
The NEW GRAVY IS GROSS
Please return to old gravy.
Everything else was great. Great servers too. Gross gravy. You need to let them know so hopefully they will bring back the original sausage gravy

This is the best bagel in Philly without question. Quality is consistent, though bagels with cream cheese are pricey.I've had a good experience with the staff at the University City location recently, always friendly and smiling when they take your order. My only negative feedback is despite already short hours, they like to start closing early (I've observed this on multiple occasions). Still this is one of my favorite places to stop by for lunch these days.

I loved eating here! Food came out so quickly and the women in charge were a DELIGHT. It was a quiet, but we were eating super early at 530pm. 

We also ate the korean dumplings (fries). So good. Would definitely order them again. 

I can't wait to return and try new dishes. I particularly want to try the korean bbq experience. We saw a customer enjoying the bbq grill experience. It was clear she was a regular. The owner was hugging and laughing with her. Love seeing that experience... hopefully that's me one day!

Came here to celebrate my birthday with my boyfriend and sister on a Friday night and we were not disappointed. 

Food: we ordered a little bit of everything. To start we had the liver pate and meatballs with polenta. The liver pate was just ok. Not my favorite. The meatballs were amazing. So soft and it just melts in your mouth. For our entrees we ordered the squid ink pasta with crab, tagliatelle with rabbit, and a margherita pizza. They were all very good, but my favorite was the squid ink pasta. It was buttery and lemony at the same time and pasta was cooked to perfection. Our waiter gave me a complimentary dessert of my choice for my birthday and I chose the panna cotta. SO GOOD! Portions were good size and pricing was reasonable. 

Atmosphere: spacious, dimly lit, classy decor. Perfect spot for date night or girls night out. Not too loud. Can accommodate small to big groups 

Service: attentive, friendly staff

Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my experience here and will definitely be coming back.

Every time I make a trip to Philly, stopping here is a necessity. The food is absolutely amazing. The staff especially are caring and want to make sure you get a full experience here. The two most prominent items on their menu are the Chicken cheesesteak and their veggie sandwich. They are very well known throughout Philly and have received many awards and accolades. 

To start off, the CHICKEN CHEESESTEAK is 100% the best item on the menu. It is made in an Indian way with different masalas. You have a choice to make it hot or mild. If you cannot handle spicy food I would stick with the mild.

The VEGGIE SANDWICH is not like regular sandwiches. It is three layers consisting of cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and more. It is a great vegetarian option for anyone who wants to try it.

Other than this the pizza is also very popular. Also, the masala fries are very flavorful. The aroma is great. There are alcoholic beverages for those who want those. The place in general is very clean as well as the bathrooms. 

All in all, I would recommend coming here for some great food that you will not experience anywhere else. It is basically Italian food with an Indian flavor blast. It's a necessity to make a stop here if your ever in Philly.

Went here at dinner time on a weeknight with a fairly large group, almost 20 people. The location was a few blocks from City Hall, by the Reading Terminal market. Big place with a big table that easily accommodated our group, however the place was otherwise mostly empty.

Our group ordered a bunch of burgers, mostly their "Beyond Burger" which is supposed to be entirely vegan (but was not unless you knew to ask them to make it so).  We got several tubs of fries and onion rings.

They offer a few wine & beers selections (nothing great) and soda (carbonated syrup) dispensers -- uck!!  I think they also had a smoothie or two. The drinks were not appetizing, and def NOT healthy.

Our fries came out first, all at once.  These were good, made fresh but a bit too salty.  The onion rings came out next - H-U-G-E. rings, OMG!  Tasty, crispy, but a bit greasy!

When our burgers came out (all together), we noticed a few (major) problems.  First, the vegan (all plant based) Beyond Burgers has a mayo sauce on every one.  That's NOT a vegan burger.  If you want your vegan burger to be vegan, you have to know to ask them to make it vegan.  Second, a few people had ordered theirs with no sauce, no ketchup, no pickle, etc.  Well, when the store manager (a friendly guy covered in tattoos) brought out our burgers on a huge tray and started handing them out, we asked which ones were without the sauce/etc.  He didn't know -- because they never labeled any of our special order items.  Wow!  Not goo

Good seafood good portions. Good sushi nice platting seats are kind of small for a booth lighting is bright they need to dem it down a bit service was a little slow for me saki was bomb though nice sweet saki bread was so good delicious bread.  Overall good seafood my salmon was amazing.

Walked over this afternoon for lunch and were seated right away near the window. Our server Costas was very attentive. We split the artichoke fonduta which was very creamy and cheesy and came with crispy bread triangles. My mom enjoyed her lobster roll and was happy the bread was crunchy and held up to the lobster. She opted for potato salad vs fries- it has a smoky and slightly spicy flavor to it which we both liked. I had a pasta which was very filling and full of veggies. We split the zeppoli for dessert.... Crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside, just the right amount of chocolate with a slightly boozy creme anglaise. We enjoyed the food, service, and view. Great choice for a quiet lunch!

We used to go to Las Palmas all the time. Recently we went and the menus completely changed. The food was smaller and service was not very good. Las Palmas has officially become too commercialized and has ruined its charm and great tasting food. Charging extra for some sauce to be on the side instead of on top of the food. We will be taking our monthly date nights to El Stuffed Pepper from now on.
District Tavern is my favorite bar! Great atmosphere and great food! It's a great place to watch lightning games.

I have been here twice and have loved it each time! Dessert was....mouthwatering! We had the Italian cake with blueberries. The pasta was so fresh each time. My only request is that they not be so stingy with the sauce cause it's great!

The food was great. The Bam Bam shrimp tacos were soooo good! My only complaint is that there really weren't many sanitary measures taken. The COVID-19 restrictions were just lifted but no employees were wearing masks and there were no capacity requirements and people were packed in the bar area as if nothing ever happened.

Great beer section and food. The bartenders are awesome the owner is always always around but you would never know it. Definitely a fun place and they have a Dj on the weekends. Make sure you asked for Joey if you eat or order drinks at the bar
Not bad, the pancakes where really good that my friend got.  A little under seasoned for my liking, but still good
Went with the fried grouper full boat. Good value at $14. The aioli sauce was delicious with the nori fries.

Eating donuts essential during pandemic.
Got my fix today, just in time before they close for summer vacation (closing Aug. 16 thru Sept. 8).
Called ahead to make sure they allow customers inside. They allow 2 customers inside at a time and masks are required. The worker had a face shield on and was very pleasant. If using cash, exact change is requested.
Been here 3 times. The pad Thai is perfect. I get it extra spicy (it's more flavor than hear). Great portions and price. Most importantly it's consistently great. What more can I ask for

The cocktails were fantastic.  We ordered three different ones and each was well balanced and I think each person said they'd order it again.  Our group also decided to share small plates.  I'd say they are more medium plates. We ordered four for three people and didn't finish them all.  Most of those were also really good - some were better than others. My favorites was mushrooms and fries. 

The atmosphere is quite a romantic, dark setting and I'd say a slightly more mature crowd. We made reservations same day, but I'd recommend making one since it is small and filled up.

Great Imo's for takeout on a Friday night!
We called in a 14" pizza, wings, and toasted ravs while we were shopping down the street. They said it would take about 15 minutes, and we were only five minutes down the road. The order was ready moments after we arrived to paid for it, and it was a solid Imo's experience.

I recommend that if your toasted ravioli aren't as golden brown as you would want, throw them in the toaster oven. Also, get your chicken wings plain with the sauce on the side for crispy and delicious wings. 

This location did it right, as we enjoyed our Friday night!

As you can see from my profile we love to try new small business locally owned establishments so today we stopped into the drunken mullet. We were so thrilled about the ambience in this place it was super cool... It was very clean and you felt welcome right away. Our server Mario did a fantastic job. We started out with the nachos and my gosh we just could not stop eating them they were so good and not like some nachos you know? These nachos had tons of ingredients on every single chips and were sooo good.  We also ordered the muffaletta to split which was amazing and we opted for the onion petals as well as the french fries which were really really really good too.  We also ordered shrimp and scallop scampi and this is why there's only four stars... The shrimp was good the seasoning on the dish was amazing the pasta it was cooked perfectly  however the scallops... Not real sure they were a little rubbery so we probably won't order that again.... it may have been a fluke not sure but as a scallop connoisseur they just did not meet the expectation! We will definitely be back though     super cool place!!!!!  Thanks Mario for not nacho shaming me for my gluttony  on those.

Excellent fresh food but the atmosphere and décor feel like it a backwoods diner.
 My wife had the chicken phone and was disappointed saying it was tasteless however my dinner was very very good with a combination of pork pork skin shrimp and chicken. Sorry voice to text

Visiting the Tampa area and found this place on Yelp. After looking through photos alone i'm sure most could agree- you want to try this! Been many places in FL and tried the "Nashville hot chicken" all over but nothing that got it quite right, in my opinion of course. Got the tenders and they were delicious! The flavor is great, the hotness doesn't overpower the overall flavor of the chicken which is hard to come by I have found. It's easy to make hot chicken but rare to find flavorful hot chicken! Recommend to try if you're in the area.

Solid Mexican Establishment that was really close to my hotel. Stopped in here during lunch time and had little wait. 

Service and food was pretty good. I got a quesadilla and was not disappointed. Prices were solid. I did not partake but they had an extensive drink menu that was probably the largest and most diverse selection in that part of town when I was there 5 or 6 years ago.

Yum! The "Best in SJ" chicken wings really did live up to their title -- I got the soy garlic flavor and they were crispy on the outside but moist on the inside. The Korean spicy seafood noodle soup (Jjamppong) was the perfect antidote to a frigid winter day. They do ask you how spicy you want it to be on a scale from 1-5. I chose 4.5 and to say the least... it was spicy... I went through like a box of tissues at least. But as a spicy food connoisseur, I enjoyed it. Service was overall very accommodating.

Eden or Dolsot House? I vote Dolsot House. 9/10

Be sure to call ahead and get your place in line since they don't take reservations. Great atmosphere, clean and Katlyn was great! Music is a tad loud as I found it difficult to have a conversation with someone across the table. Food was prompt and fresh, tasted great, and was hot. Overall a great visit minus the music and a rude waitress standing at the front when we walked in.

Very friendly and COVID safe spot. I ordered the crystal veggie dumplings (the difference between these and the regular ones; these are gluten free), and they were delicious. The dumplings were filled with minced veggies and while I didn't mind at all, the texture was an issue for my kids (they still enjoyed the flavor though).

The service was great and the food was good. It was noisy but we could have a conversation. The thing that makes it a won't return for all
Of us was the male and female shared bathroom. Definitely an  uncomfortable experience for all of us.

We came for the huge patio and were pleasantly surprised with the service and food. Our server, Stephen, was great and recommended the fajitas. I took his advice and was very happy with them. The mixed chicken and beef fajitas were great and a huge serving. My only complaint is they are served with a single tortilla- which is huge, but there is enough filling to fill 2-3 large tortillas. 
The frozen prickly pear margarita was by far the best I've found in Tucson. Lots of flavor and alcohol without the overpowering sweet and sour mix flavor. 
Chips were ok (would be better with a touch of salt) but their spicier salsa is phenomenal! 
We can't wait to return to this huge patio with our kids (where they will have plenty of room to get the wiggles out)

I had mixed feelings about my trip here. The place is absolutely adorable and takes me right to Europe. The owner/chef is also adorable and came out to check how our food was and was happy to share with us his story about moving here and starting up the restaurant. I'm glad to have a French restaurant in town to give us a little something different to try. 

The drinks: excellent

The food: mixed feelings. If you love French food, this is definitely the place to go. It feels very authentic and the chef is from France so it should be, but I wonder if I'm just not a huge fan of French food. That being said, I tried duck pate, escargot, and frog legs for the first time ever and they were all very tasty. The charcuterie board is excellent and they give you a very good portion for the money. I didn't love my main dish which was a chicken linguine. It really didn't have much flavor at all. However, the chicken was very tender and cooked well and the pasta was al dente (aka perfect). I tried my husbands steak and it was very buttery and rich (good if you like that but could also be a little overwhelming if you aren't a huge butter fan). My friend enjoyed the trout and it was dubbed the best of the 4. The other was lamb which my other friend said was good but not amazing. The crime brûlée at the end was cooked perfectly and was also good. But overall, mixed feelings. Their menu rotates which I'm happy about so I can try other items in the future.

Covid: The one thing I was disappoin
Great place to go. I wanted seafood so bad & this place was perfect. The special sauce was amazing. Definitely plan on getting more soon.

This place is relaxing and cozy. They had the fireplace going and candles lit throughout the restaurant. Service was excellent and our food came out warm. We ate the pepperoni Chicago style deep dish pizza with pretzels and beer cheese. We had over half the pizza left of a 14 in. The thick slices are very filling. We actually warmed up our leftovers the next day and it still tasted great! I can't wait to go back soon!

This amazing place tucked into the Tower Grove area is sensational. I've been lucky enough to try their unforgettable cinnamon rolls which quite literally melt in your mouth and these babies are VEGAN!! A non Vegan friend of mine was blown away by these amazing rolls. I'm confident they sell out within minutes of opening in the morning. 

I've been for lunch and their food is equally delicious. I tried the alice.walker's so fresh & so clean bowl and the kale yeah salad. The bowl was hearty with a divine, smooth curry flavor. The kale yeah salad dressing was light and savory. And their cupcakes were off the charts too. 

It's my favorite place in St. Louis for Vegan food and vegan sweets. Please try their Cinnamon Rolls...they are a must in St. Louis.

Top wings in Indy, definitely try with their homemade blue cheese dressing. Fried pickles were on point. Have been there when it was crazy busy and chaotic, sat for 20 minutes before, then waited 60 minutes for food, so only reason for 4, not 5. Went during low-capacity COVID times and got right in, was safe, and service was quick and great!

It doesn't look like much, but dang is it something. Service is off the charts, you usually meet Al every time you go, the servings are huge much I am never able to eat it all in one sitting and the price is great. This is Nashville off the beaten path right here. Southern Cooking!

Personally, I don't eat meat but our Hawaiian wedding was canceled due to Covid so we used City BBQ to cater our small local wedding. We still wanted to try to bring some Hawaiian fare to our shindig. Pulled pork, macaroni, & potato salad meet the standards of a a Hawaiian plate lunch on the west side of Indy. The banana pudding for perfectly into theme. 

We chose the catering option with the cute set-up & staff. It was beautiful, all the staff went above & beyond, and everyone talked nonstop about how good the food was. They had a black bean burger option for us herbivores. 

It's a really affordable option for wedding catering. Everyone left full and with leftovers (I brought to-go containers).

Boyfriend thought it'd be a cute date if we went to the mall and had PF Chang's for lunch, so we went and it was pretty good. We got egg rolls and crispy green beans for an appetizer and omg SO GOOD!! The green beans had my boyfriend drooling lol. We split the chicken and pork fried rice and that was super good as well. Service was good and things were kept clean. At one point a server unknowingly dropped a wrapper off a tray and another one picked it up when he saw it on the ground, so that shows initiative by the servers. The reason I'm giving 4 stars is that when we were seated my seat had a ton of rips in it and it was very uncomfortable against my bare legs, but my boyfriend had longer shorts on so we switched. They also don't offer military discount with is disappointing:( but other than that the food was great.

Love the friendly Yats family in Carmel!  You guys are the best!
Karen T.
No dogs allowed, and it was much too hot to leave Mr Joe Bite'n in the car. For a burger or salad, there are other places in town with the same cuisine that is canine friendly.

I haven't really been into Mediterranean that much, but recently got a craving for hummus. And said why not go here. Erik or Erick or however his name is spelled suggested the lamb shawarma, and by god it was delightful! Definitely recommend anybody to at least give it a try. Will likely come back for more when I'm down here again!!! Thanks you guys!

Their pizza is really pretty good for Reno. But the fact that you have to order 2 hours before they open in order to MAYBE get a pizza is awful. Every time I've ordered from here I felt like I was trying to win concert tickets from the radio calling anywhere from 10-30 times with a busy signal. When it comes down to it, it's just not worth the hassle.

If I could give this restaurant 10 stars I would. My boyfriend and I always participate in Center City Restaurant Week and this was by far our favorite discovery. The staff was friendly and made us feel like family. They offer a fixed menu price on certain weekdays where you can get 3 large courses for just $30. The food is absolutely delectable. My favorite was the gnocchi in cream sauce. I will definitely return and would recommend to anyone looking for some phenomenal Italian food with a homey feel.
I love the New York style pizza from here. The crust is perfect. The staff is super nice as well. Love pizza night from here. It's in our regular rotation for pizza!
